tokens.npc_dota_hero_abyssal_underlord_bio:
Neither myth nor song exist to tell of their coming.

Deep below the surface of the world lay unknown wonders and horrors. Down and down again, well beneath the slithering magma fields and simmering roots of dormant volcanoes stands the obsidian city of Aziyog, its incomparable stonework spanning an endless cavern. Within honeycomb walls mortared with the bones of countless slaves lies the domain of the Abyssal Horde, and their brutal underlord Vrogros.

Armed by the monstrous forgemasters of his kind and well-practiced in the arts of the Dark Rift, Vrogros is able to conjure forth flame and crippling malice through the twist between worlds. He seeks always to expand his holdings, destroying or enslaving all he encounters. Yet the lands offered by the subterranean realm are few, and so his sights have turned upward. By his command the first waves of abyssal invaders have already marched through the rift, a few doomed legions meant merely to test the might of nations above. Now, as his full force readies itself for unending conquest, Vrogros himself steps into a sunlit world to announce his coming reign. Those who face the Underlord will bow and pay tribute, or be crushed where they stand.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_abyssal_underlord_hype: Conjure waves of abyssal flame to immolate enemies held paralyzed in your spiteful grip. Feast upon the carnage of battle, gaining strength as foes perish around you, their attacks diminished by your very presence. Tear a rift in reality to teleport yourself and your teammates across the map, delivering bloody retribution to any who would defy the will of Vrogros the Underlord.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-3-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-3-2.png|84px]]
** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Pit of Malice cast range}}+{{#var:Pit of Malice value1}}}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
** Applies the following ability effects on affected enemy units:
*** {{M|Root}}
*** {{M|True Sight}}
** Affects the following units:
*** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*** {{M|Invisible}} units.

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice_buff_placer}}
** The debuff has three main components:
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Root}}
**** Applies a {{#var:Pit of Malice value4}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Pit of Malice value4 tal}}|25tal}})-second [[root]] to non-debuff-affected enemy units within the radius.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Root}}
**** Has the following properties:
***** Applies the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} instance per valid debuff proc.
***** The debuff is continuously applied periodically to enemy units within the effect radius.
***** Does not reapply itself to debuff-affected enemy units.
**** This affects the following things:
***** Debuff-affected enemy units are not continuously rooted for the entire duration.
***** The debuff functions as a [[root]] downtime for each valid enemy unit within the radius, and roots them correspondingly to whenever they are within the radius.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}}
**** All Pit of Malice instances utilizes the same debuff.
**** Multiple overlapping Pit of Mailice do not stack — in short, once [[root]]ed, the debuff-affected enemy cannot be affected again until the debuff expires.

* {{cf|talnotes}} Learning the {{ValueColor||movement speed slow|15tal}} {{M|talent|t=t2r}} immediately update all current instances.

fields.value:
{{Teleportcard}} {{Spellunit | name = Fiend's Gate | desc0 = Right-click initiates the channeling, and warping through the Fiend's Gate.

Underlord immediately starts channeling the teleport upon cast. This can be manually canceled by Underlord. | icon1 = Underlord Fiend's Gate Warp | type1 = bsc | target1 = Passive | desc1 = Warp is an innate, hidden ability, for units who has this ability. Units who do not have Warp may not channel the Fiend's Gate. | icon2 = Invulnerability | type2 = bsc | target2 = Passive | desc2 = {{Show|A|Fiend's Gate|Invulnerability|desc0}} }} * Globally {{Code|!}} pings on all heroes' minimap upon cast, indicating where both portals are placed. * {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} ** Interrupts Underlord's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast, and automatically channels the Fiend's Gate in front of him. *** Stop commands may cancel the automatic channeling. ** {{Symbol|Channeling}} *** The self-channeling component is interrupted, and stops the {{M|teleport}} component from happening, if Underlord is affected by the following sources while channeling: **** {{M|Cyclone}} sources. **** {{M|Root}} sources. **** {{M|Stun}} sources. **** {{M|Sleep}} sources. ** {{Symbol|fx|v}} *** The red radius indicator centered around Underlord indicates the restricted area for the exit portal. * {{Symbol|Fiend's Gate}} ** Creates 1 {{Symbol|a|Enter}} Entrance Portal and 1 {{Symbol|a|Exit}} Exit Portal upon cast. ** Both portals have a {{A|Fiend's Gate|Spell Immunity}} buff. *** Hence, enemy heroes can ping the buff to print out the unit's remaining duration. *** {{Symbol|a|Exit}} **** Has to be {{#var:Fiend's Gate value2}} radius away of Underlord and cannot be placed in the following areas: **** Inside the {{M|fountain}} area, including the fountain ramps. **** Inside {{M|Roshan}}'s pit. **** On {{M|impassable terrain}}. **** On spots obscured by {{M|buildings}} or {{M|trees}}. ** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}} *** Grants a non-lingering 200-radius [[flying vision]] centered around both portals. ** {{Symbol|Trees}} *** Trees within 200-radius centered around both portals are destroyed. ** {{Symbol|Aura}} *** {{cf|talnotes}} Creates a negative [[aura]] upon cast that deals {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} to enemy units in 1-second intervals within the radius, immediate upon debuff application, centered around both portals. **** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}} ***** Multiple overlapping Fiend's Gate radius do not stack.
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Now creates {{A|Underlord|Pit of Malice}} of its corresponding level centered on both portals. ** Works independently of Pit of Malice's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}. ** Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}. ** Checks if Underlord has the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} upon cast. Hence, it does not update the current instance.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_abyssal_underlord
data.bio_loc:
Neither myth nor song exist to tell of their coming.

Deep below the surface of the world lay unknown wonders and horrors. Down and down again, well beneath the slithering magma fields and simmering roots of dormant volcanoes stands the obsidian city of Aziyog, its incomparable stonework spanning an endless cavern. Within honeycomb walls mortared with the bones of countless slaves lies the domain of the Abyssal Horde, and their brutal underlord Vrogros.

Armed by the monstrous forgemasters of his kind and well-practiced in the arts of the Dark Rift, Vrogros is able to conjure forth flame and crippling malice through the twist between worlds. He seeks always to expand his holdings, destroying or enslaving all he encounters. Yet the lands offered by the subterranean realm are few, and so his sights have turned upward. By his command the first waves of abyssal invaders have already marched through the rift, a few doomed legions meant merely to test the might of nations above. Now, as his full force readies itself for unending conquest, Vrogros himself steps into a sunlit world to announce his coming reign. Those who face the Underlord will bow and pay tribute, or be crushed where they stand.
data.hype_loc: Conjure waves of abyssal flame to immolate enemies held paralyzed in your spiteful grip. Feast upon the carnage of battle, gaining strength as foes perish around you, their attacks diminished by your very presence. Tear a rift in reality to teleport yourself and your teammates across the map, delivering bloody retribution to any who would defy the will of Vrogros the Underlord.
data.npe_desc_loc: Teleports his team in and out of battle

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_firestorm
abilities.desc_loc: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
abilities.lore_loc: The flames of conquest blaze forth from the darkest depths of the abyss.
abilities.shard_loc: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice
abilities.desc_loc: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every %pit_interval% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Twisting into the seams of reality itself, Vrogros' manifest hatred paralyzes those who defy his will.

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura
abilities.desc_loc: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
abilities.lore_loc: To merely stand in the presence of the Underlord is to feel the conviction of battle sapped from one's soul.
notes_loc: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.
facets_loc: Underlord's attacks cleave while he has bonus damage from Atrophy Aura.

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_raid_boss
abilities.desc_loc: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive %dark_portal_multiplier%x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_dark_portal
abilities.desc_loc: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least %minimum_distance% away from each other.
abilities.lore_loc: They come without warning, leaving fire and blood where kingdoms once flourished.
notes_loc: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain
abilities.scepter_loc: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.
facets_loc: Underlord summons uncontrollable demonic Warriors and Archers after travelling through the Fiend's Gate that attack nearby enemies. These units deal %underling_building_damage_reduction_tooltip%%% damage to buildings.
